description: Retrieves a scoped payment credential for a session the customer has authorized. The credential is an agentic PAN from Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay, or a card from the customer's Stripe Link wallet. It is limited to the approved amount and merchant. The customer's real card number is never returned. Use the credential only to complete the purchase.

merchantUrl.description: Optional website URL of the merchant the credentials will be used on

name: get_payment_credentials
